method.method_draft: Use the visual rectangle structure to reason from right triangles instead of citing the diagonal theorem directly. In rectangle JKLM, diagonal JL is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs equal to the rectangle’s width and height, and diagonal KM is the hypotenuse of another right triangle with the same two leg lengths. By the Pythagorean theorem, both diagonals have the same squared length, so JL = KM. Then use the text-given expressions 2x + 5 and 4x - 11, set 2x + 5 = 4x - 11, and solve for x = 8.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中，JKLM 是一个矩形，J 在左下，K 在右下，L 在右上，M 在左上；线段 JL 从左下到右上，线段 MK 从左上到右下，它们是矩形的两条对角线并相交于 N。推理：设矩形的宽为 w、高为 h。对角线 JL 是一个直角三角形的斜边，其两条直角边分别是矩形的宽和高，所以 JL^2 = w^2 + h^2。对角线 KM 也是另一个直角三角形的斜边，直角边同样是矩形的宽和高，所以 KM^2 = w^2 + h^2。因此 JL 和 KM 的长度相等。题中给出 JL = 2x + 5，KM = 4x - 11，所以 2x + 5 = 4x - 11。解得 16 = 2x，因此 x = 8。
